evidence_provenance.workspace_log_base: Task workspace above outputs/100letter; work logs are not bundled in the Git repository.
evidence_provenance.transcript_only_results: Physical, attachment and deduction results are executor-confirmed tool outputs. The other entries cite preserved stdout or machine reports. No historical source hash is invented for old unit runs.
evidence_provenance.hash_policy: Source SHA-256 values identify files at report capture time, not an atomic historical checkout used by every run. File timestamps and post-run edits are recorded separately. This document does not bind an executable release or later video to these hashes.
